title: Intuit Developer Prompt Library Configuration
description: Schema for prompt-config.json — validates configurable and static fields used by merge-prompt.js

integration_mode.description: Whether to scaffold a new project or produce importable modules for an existing codebase

language_framework.description: Target language or framework for generated code (e.g., Python3, TypeScript, Java)

type_of_transaction.description: QuickBooks transaction type (must be all lowercase)

typing_system.description: Type system style for the chosen language (e.g., hints (dataclasses), Pydantic models)

transaction_creation_instructions.description: Free-form instructions for creating a Dimensions-tagged transaction

markup_percentages.description: Markup percentage for Project Estimate cost calculations (positive value = profit, negative value = loss)

project_estimate_creation_instructions.description: Free-form instructions for creating a Project Estimate

graphql_schema.description: URL to the GraphQL schema documentation

create_dimension_qbo_ui.description: URL to create dimensions in the QuickBooks UI

transaction_v3_api_endpoint.description: REST V3 endpoint for creating transactions

get_transaction_endpoint.description: REST V3 endpoint for reading a transaction

transaction_v3_estimate_api_endpoint.description: REST V3 endpoint for creating a Project Estimate

get_estimate_transaction_endpoint.description: REST V3 endpoint for reading a Project Estimate

rest_baseurl_production.description: Production REST API base URL (host only, no scheme)

rest_baseurl_sandbox.description: Sandbox REST API base URL (host only, no scheme)

minorversion.description: QuickBooks REST API minorversion to use in query strings

company_info_rest_v3_api_endpoint.description: REST V3 endpoint for querying CompanyInfo

company_preferences_rest_v3_api_endpoint.description: REST V3 endpoint for querying Company Preferences

project-estimate-documentation.description: URL to Project Estimate use-case documentation

rest_v3_api_documentation.description: URL to REST V3 API reference documentation

dimension_discovery_query.description: GraphQL query for fetching dimension definitions

dimension_values_query.description: GraphQL query for fetching dimension values

project_creation_query.description: GraphQL mutation for creating a project

java-sdk-official.description: URL to official Java SDK on Maven Central

java-sdk-dependency.description: Build tool for Java SDK dependency (e.g., Gradle, Maven)

java-sdk-documentation.description: URL to Java SDK installation documentation

custom_field_documentation.description: URL to the Custom Fields use-case documentation

custom_field_scope_readwrite.description: OAuth scope required for read/write access to custom field definitions

custom_field_definitions_query.description: GraphQL query for fetching custom field definitions

custom_field_create_definition_mutation.description: GraphQL mutation for creating a custom field definition

custom_field_create_definition_variables.description: Example variables payload for the create custom field definition mutation

custom_field_update_definition_mutation.description: GraphQL mutation for updating a custom field definition

custom_field_update_definition_variables.description: Example variables payload for the update custom field definition mutation

custom_field_disable_variables_example.description: Example variables payload for disabling a custom field definition

custom_field_payload_structure.description: JSON shape of the custom field values attached to a transaction

custom_field_transaction_creation_instru.description: Free-form instructions for creating a transaction with custom field values

custom_field_sample_app_java.description: URL to the official Custom Fields Java sample app

custom_field_sample_app_python.description: URL to the official Custom Fields Python sample app

sales_tax_documentation.description: URL to the Sales Tax use-case documentation

sales_tax_scope.description: OAuth scope required for the Sales Tax calculation API

sales_tax_calculate_mutation.description: GraphQL mutation for calculating sale transaction tax

sales_tax_calculate_variables_example.description: Example variables payload for the sales tax calculation mutation

sales_tax_sample_app_java.description: URL to the official Sales Tax Java sample app

sales_tax_sample_app_python.description: URL to the official Sales Tax Python sample app

sales_tax_sample_app_nodejs.description: URL to the official Sales Tax Node.js sample app
